import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
import ast
def task_func(csv_file):
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_file)
    df['list'] = df['list'].map(ast.literal_eval)
    df['sum'] = df['list'].apply(np.sum)
    df['mean'] = df['list'].apply(np.mean)
    df['std'] = df['list'].apply(np.std)
    ax = sns.histplot(df['mean'])
    return df, ax

import ast
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
def task_func(csv_file):
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_file)
    df['dict_column'] = df['dict_column'].apply(lambda x: ast.literal_eval(x) if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    dict_df = df['dict_column'].apply(pd.Series)
    for col in dict_df.columns:
        df[col] = dict_df[col]
    numeric_dict_df = dict_df.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    other_numeric = df.drop(columns=['dict_column']).select_dtypes(include='number')
    numeric_df = pd.concat([numeric_dict_df, other_numeric], axis=1)
    numeric_df = numeric_df.dropna(axis=1, how='all')
    ax = sns.pairplot(numeric_df)
    return df, ax
